macros.name: showcmd
macros.doc: The \showcmd command displays a command like TeX’s \show, but with a little bonus: it also checks if the macros takes an optional argument (like some commands defined with \newcommand do), or was made robust by using \DeclareRobustCommand or fixltx2e’s \MakeRobust.

macros.name: showcs
macros.doc: The \showcs command does the same thing as \showcmd, but takes the command’s name as its argument: \showcmd\truc is equivalent to \showcs{truc}.
